published_ranges._notes: No official Bambu PLA Lite TDS found. Print/drying values and max volumetric speed 16 mm3/s (default print temp 210C; nozzles 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm) come from a Bambu Lab PLA Lite product sheet hosted by reseller Big Dipper (Argentina). Density 1.4 g/cm3 is also given in the comparison table of Bambu's official PLA Pure TDS V1.0. Matte finish. Neither source states a diameter (the reseller file name carries SKU BL-A18-D0-1.75-1000-SPL).
